whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` specifier in `[dev-packages]`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `*` specifier in `[dev-packages]`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Pipfile no longer carries a `*` specifier in `[dev-packages]`.
